study.question: Do signed within-cell age third central moments supply predictive distribution-shape evidence beyond the frozen exchangeable history, conditional mean and observed-variance source, rather than extra capacity, unoriented shape magnitude or bin-global shape?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitations: early broad continuous fusion lost to duplicated histogram (round18 AUC .62197269 vs .62216595; round19 .62227116 vs .62250866). Centered per-bin means then improved over a histogram readout (round20 .62259365 vs .62232134), but removing a shared mean had only a tiny advantage over raw means (round21 .62263160 vs .62260331). The current observed-variance model (.62323610) exceeds conditional variance (.62279214), pooled variance (.62307389) and duplicate means (.62282964), while duplicate means has better logloss (.19356017 vs .19358878). These successful executions include negative mechanism findings; none is a repetition or causal proof. Current code retains only the first two within-cell fraction moments, so reflected asymmetric distributions can agree on all parent features yet have opposite third moments. Hypothesis: which side of the local age mean carries the longer tail adds usable evidence. This is provisional and distinct from standardized skewness or a claim about unseen full histories.

study.proposed_difference: Append a fourth gated compact residual. For each of64 match/action/coarse-bin cells compute empirical third central moment t=mean((fraction-mean(fraction))^3), with t=0 for n<=2. Input=6*sqrt(3)*log1p(n)/log129*t. This is signed bounded moment, not variance-normalized skewness. Controls replace only input with abs(signed), count-weighted within-cell third moments pooled over match/action in the same impression/bin (excluding between-mean terms), or4*histogram*cell_variance duplicated from parent. All four maps execute in every variant. Allocation2112 head+2176 context=4256 extra parameters; expected17204595 total. The hypothesis follows local evidence; no external source priority, transfer or novelty claim is established.
